title: Sonic and the gold rings.
lines: On a green island with hills that go up and down like a roller coaster lives a hedgehog.
Sonic is blue, with green eyes, red shoes and spikes on his back.
When Sonic runs, all you see is a blue streak.
There are gold rings all over the island.
Sonic collects them as he runs.
Sonic also has a best friend.
Tails, a little orange fox with two tails.
Tails can spin his tails like a helicopter.
He can make and fix anything.
One morning Sonic is sunbathing on a rock.
Doctor Eggman is up to something again!
Doctor Eggman is a man with a big moustache and a round tummy, like an egg.
He lives in a big factory full of smoke.
And he wants the whole island for himself.
He's catching the animals of the forest, says Tails.
The bunnies, the birds, the squirrels.
They go through the green forest, over the hills, through a big loop.
Sonic runs upside down, round and round, and on.
Then they come to Doctor Eggman's factory.
There are robots at the door.
Big iron robots, with red eyes.
He curls up into a blue ball.
He spins and spins, faster and faster.
And out of the robot jumps a little bunny.
It hops away to the forest.
Sonic and Tails run into the factory.
An animal jumps out of every robot.
A little hedgehog, just like Sonic, but very small.
Doctor Eggman, in his flying machine.
He flies away, high into the sky.
And together they fly up, after the machine.
Sonic lets go and curls up.
He lands on top of the machine.
And the machine flies away, very far, beyond the horizon.
All the animals are back in the forest.
They throw a big party for Sonic and Tails.
There's fruit and there are chili dogs, Sonic's favourite food.
The bunny gives Sonic a gold ring.
For you, because you saved us.
But you know, I couldn't have done it alone.
Tails goes all red with pride.
On your marks, get set, go!
